newsitem.title: UK: Blacks Leisure like-for-like sales up 10%.
newsitem.headline: Blacks Leisure like-for-like sales up 10%.

text.p: British sports equipment and fashion retailer Blacks Leisure Group Plc said on Friday that like-for-like sales in the 20 weeks to July 19 climbed by 10 percent compared with the same period a year earlier.
Like-for-like sales at First Sport, the group's sports retail chain, was up 11 percent over the previous year, in line with expectations, the company said in a statement.
Blacks Outdoor, the group's outdoor leisure retailer, also reported an 11 percent rise in like-for-like sales, assisted by the unseasonably wet start to the summer.
The group said it had opened nine stores since May and shut three. It now has a total portfolio of 125 stores.
